title: 第11章 夜晚袭杀第12章 流民父子
content_zh:
;;
这段时日，清江县周边十几个县都有不少的流民涌入。
像许明巍这类遭遇闷棍的，也不是个例。
只不过一般出门在外，都不会有人带太多财物，加之事后遍寻不到，又没有闹出人命，这才不了了之。
数日来，许川在自己家周边都看到了鬼祟的人影。
于是就在围墙附近设置了一些机关，诸如钉子，老鼠夹之类的。
如果有人翻墙进来，定会吃亏。
还有就是警示类的铃铛。
中机关的同时，警示铃铛也会响彻四周。
【今日卦象：中下，今日子时有五人翻墙而入，欲杀人夺财】
许川心中冷冷一笑。
许家在洞溪村名声赫赫，又没有徐家那般多的家丁护卫，被盯上十分正常。
“不知道这几人中有没有武者？”
“但即便几率小，也必须防备一二。”
仅仅那些钉子和老鼠夹，对普通流民来说足以，但若是碰到武者，作用就有限了。
他制作了一些简易的箭弩，入夜之后安置在两侧的屋檐。
触发机关，就会引发这些箭弩的乱射，然后撤掉了警示铃铛。
今日外出，许川就简单地巡视一圈。
心中思虑的都是今晚的事。
“石头，今晚可能会有贼人来劫掠，子时前一刻，你持弓待在屋顶，看准机会进行射杀，能做到吗？”

许川突兀地说道，表情十分的凝重。
“阿爹，这是真的吗？”
“你信阿爹的话，就照阿爹的话去做，这关乎我们全家人的安危。”
许明巍没有再去多问，“知道了阿爹，我都听你的。”
他虽然没有三流武者的实力，但天生神力下，加上锐利鹰眼和远程弓箭，夜色下突然袭击，即便对二流武者都有很大的威胁。
“阿爹，那要不要在箭头上淬毒。”
“你不会觉得心里不适吗？”许川有些意外地看着许明巍。
只见许明巍的双眸变得锐利起来，宛若刀锋一般，似有杀意凝聚。
“敢威胁到家人的，必须永绝后患。”
“嗯。”许川点点头，“按照你自己的想法做就行。”
夜晚。
皎洁的月盘躲入一朵乌云的后面，繁星晦暗不定。
床榻上。
许川静静躺着，血气充足。
“夫君，妾身帮你泄泄火气吧。”
许川一反常态，微微一笑，“这火气还有其它作用，留着正合适。”
白静有些不解。
啥用处？
还想用在其他人身上不成？
白静想象中的其他人自然是指其他女子。

“好了，今晚早些歇息，明日还要早起。”
content_en:
;;
During this period, there was an influx of refugees from more than a dozen counties around Qingjiang County.
People like Xu Mingwei who suffer from sap are not alone.
It's just that no one usually takes too much property with them when they go out. In addition, it can't be found afterward, and no one was killed, so it was left to nothing.
In the past few days, Xu Chuan has seen sneaky figures around his home.
So some mechanisms were set up near the wall, such as nails, mouse traps and the like.
If someone climbs over the wall and comes in, they will definitely suffer.
There are also warning bells.
When the trap is hit, the warning bell will ring all around.
[Today’s hexagram: middle and lower, today at midnight, five people climbed over the wall and entered, intending to kill people and seize wealth]
Xu Chuan smiled coldly in his heart.
The Xu family has a great reputation in Dongxi Village, and there are not as many servants as the Xu family to protect them, so it is normal for them to be targeted.
"I wonder if there are any warriors among these people?"
"But even if the chance is small, we still have to be on guard."
Just those nails and mouse traps are enough for ordinary refugees, but if they encounter warriors, their effect will be limited.
He made some simple crossbows and placed them on the eaves on both sides after nightfall.
Triggering the mechanism will cause these arrows and crossbows to fire randomly, and then the warning bell will be removed.
When he went out today, Xu Chuan simply took a look around.
All I was thinking about was tonight.
"Stone, there may be thieves coming to rob them tonight. Just before midnight, you stay on the roof with a bow and look for opportunities to shoot. Can you do it?"
Xu Chuan said abruptly, his expression very solemn.
"Dad, is this true?"
"If you believe what my father says, then do it. This is related to the safety of our whole family."
Xu Mingwei didn't ask any more questions, "I know, Dad, I will listen to you."
Although he does not have the strength of a third-rate warrior, with his natural divine power, sharp eagle eyes, and long-range bow and arrow, a sudden attack at night is a great threat to even a second-rate warrior.
"Dad, how about quenching poison on the arrowhead?"
"Don't you feel uncomfortable?" Xu Chuan looked at Xu Mingwei with some surprise.
Xu Mingwei's eyes became sharper, like blades, and he seemed to have murderous intent.
"Those who dare to threaten their families must never cause further trouble."
"Yeah." Xu Chuan nodded, "Just do it according to your own ideas."
night.
The bright moon disk hid behind a dark cloud, and the stars were dim and uncertain.
On the bed.
Xu Chuan lay quietly with full blood.
"Husband, I will help you vent your anger."
Xu Chuan was uncharacteristically smiling and said, "This anger has other uses, so it's just right to keep it."
Bai Jing was a little confused.
What's the use?
Do you want to use it on others?
The other people in Bai Jing's imagination naturally refer to other women.
"Okay, rest early tonight, and get up early tomorrow."
